q1_issues.issue: `freedom_of_worship` is a fused multi-word compound emitted with no decomposition atoms and no typing atom at all, so nothing connects the symbol to `freedom` or to `worship` as the compound section requires whenever a compound symbol is used.

q2_gaps: a head-noun + of-complement fixed nominal ("freedom of worship", "freedom of speech") — the compound section enumerates only `verb_object`, `verb_particle`, `modifier_noun` and agent-nominalizations, so this shape has no prescribed fusion-or-split decision and no decomposition form
notes: `Antinomic` follows the licensed "is similar to" + `(Symmetric …)` template exactly, and `(Degree islam antinomic absolutely)` matches the intensifier rule with the surface -ly adverb kept, the relation atom serving as the retained positive. The claim is a contestable evaluative generalization asserted at (STV 1.0 0.99), which is defensible only because "Islam" is parsed as a named individual rather than a generalization.
